title: SituHOI: Scalable Capture of Scene-Situated Full-Body Human-Object Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.23980v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modeling human-object interaction (HOI) in real environments requires jointly representing whole-body motion, manipulated objects, and scene geometry, yet existing datasets trade off scalable capture against structured, scene-aligned supervision. We introduce SituHOI, a large-scale RGB-D dataset containing 18,429 annotated clips across 16 indoor rooms and approximately 86 hours of quality-screened activity. It pairs recordings from a single moving RGB-D camera with static scene scans, object geometry, language descriptions, and estimated human and object trajectories. Using the scans as persistent references, our pipeline combines camera localization and depth-based metric alignment with human mesh recovery, object tracking, and temporal refinement to register all geometric annotations in a shared floor-aligned frame. translated_title: SituHOI：场景情境下全身人-物交互的可扩展捕捉
translated_abstract: 在真实环境中建模人-物交互（HOI）需要联合表示全身运动、被操作物体和场景几何，然而现有数据集在可扩展捕捉与结构化、场景对齐的监督之间难以两全。我们提出SituHOI，这是一个大规模RGB-D数据集，包含16个室内房间中的18,429条标注片段，约86小时经过质量筛选的活动数据。该数据集将单个移动RGB-D相机的录制内容与静态场景扫描、物体几何、语言描述以及估计得到的人体和物体轨迹相配对。以场景扫描作为持久参考，我们的流水线将相机定位与基于深度的度量对齐、人体网格恢复、物体跟踪及时序细化相结合，将所有几何标注配准到一个共享的、与地板对齐的坐标系中。这些数据支持FlexHOI-Bench——一个具有可变观测条件的目标导向联合运动预测基准……
tldr: SituHOI是一个大规模RGB-D人-物交互数据集，通过将单目移动相机视频与静态场景扫描进行配准的自动化流水线，实现了场景对齐的全身交互捕捉，并支持目标条件联合运动预测基准FlexHOI-Bench。
en_tdlr: SituHOI is a large-scale RGB-D dataset enabling scalable capture of scene-aligned full-body human-object interactions by registering single moving-camera recordings with static scene scans, supporting FlexHOI-Bench, a goal-conditioned joint motion prediction benchmark.
